mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC (-22.4 to -13.3) and TRANSIT (-37.1 to -26.6) have risen monotonically together for four consecutive weeks, indicating a self-sustaining reopening drift in out-of-home activity; the same drift carries RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose 9.1 points from t-3w (-22.4) to t-0w (-13.3)
fact:TRANSIT rose 10.5 points from t-3w (-37.1) to t-0w (-26.6)
regime_hint: steady reopening with no new restrictions
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its last-28-day mean while TRANSIT continues to rise week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -30 (from -30.4 at t-1w to -26.6 at t-0w) is a discrete commuting-recovery marker; once transit volume passes this level, weekday trips to shopfronts follow within roughly two weeks, lifting RETAIL_REC.

failure_condition: In the two weeks after TRANSIT first exceeds -30.0, RETAIL_REC fails to post a higher weekly mean than its prior week.

fact:PARKS rose 20.0 points from t-3w (-14.4) to t-0w (5.6)

mechanism_narrative: With Victorian restrictions actively easing through February 2022, the WORKPLACES recovery (-17.0 to -11.3) is policy-enabled rather than organic; continued easing keeps office-adjacent retail catchments repopulating and drives RETAIL_REC higher across four weeks.

regime_hint: active easing of COVID-19 restrictions with no new mandates
failure_condition: While easing remains in force and WORKPLACES keeps improving at least 1 point per week, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM pinned near +9 for four weeks while RESIDENTIAL stays positive signals persistent precautionary, home-anchored consumption; that stickiness caps discretionary trips and keeps RETAIL_REC from exceeding its recent mean over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Melbourne's late-summer to early-autumn transition shifts discretionary time out of outdoor recreation into indoor commercial venues; as PARKS retreats from its recent +5.6 peak toward seasonal norms, that reallocated time mechanically lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose 20.0 points over the window and now sits at +5.6, an unusual late-summer outdoor peak
fact:RETAIL_REC gained 9.1 points over the same window
failure_condition: PARKS declines from +5.6 over the next four weeks while RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is not above its last-28-day mean.
